title: Live peer route status, output closure, and validation methods
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local source/test crosswalk; plan-only

Separate issue status, named source-commit behavior, merged/released behavior, and local control coverage.
Review how LibreDWG's documented test scripts establish structural, differential, and native-converter evidence.

sources.revision: GitHub issue, PR, and master-source pages reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: Issue #1351 remains open in the page snapshot although its author says the exact synthetic repro passes on master commit 56a05f98. PR #1360 remains open/unmerged; its author says it repairs the specific #1355 decode-loss input but explicitly leaves silent-success reporting unresolved. #1408 has no public sample/minimal reproducer. #1413 reports root-DICTIONARY ordering loss. LibreDWG documents filtered text diffs and a cross-format script that depends on ODA File Converter.

The reports cover standalone AC1032 MLeader context-object no-op writer losses, an R2009 GeoData Civil-tail/units writer issue, culture-sensitive Turkish/Azeri codepage folding, and a peer signed-short EED length overflow. The MLeader and GeoData reports do not provide public source drawings; none is a local reproduction or a normative DWG field-order source.
INSERT group 66 value 1 requires a following ATTRIB sequence terminated by SEQEND. DXF sections have explicit ENDSEC closure and the full file has explicit EOF.
The OBJECTS root dictionary is position-sensitive for readers and is expected first; this supports using identity/order controls, not lowest-handle selection.

planChanges: Distinguish current issue status from the exact named source commit, package/release behavior, and whether a proposed correction is merged/released.
Keep decode success, record/object dispositions, DXF/DWG structural closure, strict independent reopen, semantic comparison, and native audit as independent evidence stages.
Reuse current local generated-test owners when they already cover a report shape; add tests only for a confirmed uncovered local source invariant.
Keep peer/native execution to an optional composed checkpoint and out of the routine per-slice validation loop.
limitations: Research was a source/issue/document crosswalk only; no external runtime or native CAD application was executed.
Peer issue reports, even with a named reproduction, are version- and route-specific and do not prove a libdxfrw defect.
No private ACadSharp/LibreDWG DWG/DXF samples were retrieved or used.
No local test command was run because this pass made a plan/receipt-only update; the plan diff was checked for whitespace errors.
